name: BENETEAU SA BENETEAU ORD SHS
summary: Beneteau SA is a French boat builder that designs, manufactures, and markets a wide range of sailboats and motorboats. The company's brands include Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon, and Prestige, catering to various segments of the recreational boating market. Beneteau is headquartered in Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie, France
